description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing an item's quantity updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with exactly one item in the cart at quantity 1. The line total and cart total are noted before the change.
steps: Note the item's unit price, its line total and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the item from 1 to 2.
cases.expected: The item's line total is updated to reflect the new quantity, and the cart total is updated accordingly.

cases.title: Increasing the quantity of one item in a multi-item cart
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with two different items in the cart, each at quantity 1.
steps: Note both line totals and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the first item from 1 to 3.
Observe the first item's line total.
Observe the second item's line total.
cases.expected: The first item's line total is updated for the new quantity, the second item's line total is unchanged, and the cart total is updated.

cases.title: Removing one item from a cart that contains several items
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with three different items in the cart.
steps: Note the three items listed and the cart total.
Remove the second item from the cart.
cases.expected: The removed item no longer appears in the cart list, the other two items remain, and the cart total is updated to exclude the removed item.

cases.title: Removing the last remaining item shows the empty cart message
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with exactly one item in the cart.
steps: Remove the only item from the cart.
cases.expected: The item is removed from the list and an empty cart message is shown (exact message text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with two different items in the cart, one of them at a quantity greater than 1.
steps: Note the items in the cart, their quantities and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
Observe the cart contents after the page reloads.
cases.expected: The same items with the same quantities are still in the cart and the cart total is the same as before the refresh.
